queries_run: MACOM Technology Solutions distribution channel shift 2026
MACOM MTSI business model transition go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: MACOM 維持多通路（直銷、應用工程、獨立業務代表、經銷商）；經銷商營收占比 FY2023 24.0%→FY2024 29.3%→FY2025 32.3%，兩家 reseller 各占 12.4%、11.2%。通路占比上升但屬既有通路內的比重變動，非訂閱化／D2C／平台化。
findings.excerpt: Sales to our distributors accounted for 32.3%, 29.3% and 24.0% of our revenue in fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年通路破壞、訂閱化或 D2C 轉型的來源；變動屬終端市場結構（資料中心占比上升），非通路。
